label: Finding-92
title: preannounce-time: 1 smaller precision and sourcing point
description: The feed's 20:32Z is not a competing publication time: Alan Coopersmith's oss-security message quoting the php.net archive URL is dated 20:22:51Z, ten minutes before the feed's <published>2026-10-20T20:32:00+00:00>, so the feed timestamp is an authoring or rebuild time. The dispute is between 19:30 and 'around 20:00', both earlier than 20:22:51Z.
